title: Dithered QR Codes
summary: An exploration of applying dithering techniques (pixel pattern halftoning) to QR codes to create visually interesting effects while maintaining scannability, likely demonstrating the technical challenge of preserving error correction while creating aesthetic patterns.
problem_solved: Demonstrates how to create visually artistic QR codes using dithering patterns without breaking the code's scannability
why_valuable: Combines creative coding with practical utility, showing that functional elements like QR codes can also be aesthetically pleasing through algorithmic image processing techniques
